description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called `ProductGrid`, which displays a grid of product items with features like lazy loading, error handling, and empty state messages. It uses Provider for state management and includes custom child widgets such as `ProductCard`, `ErrorDisplay`, and `ShimmerProductCard`.

classes.name: ProductGrid
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a grid list of products, handling loading, errors, and empty states with lazy loading on scroll.

classes.name: _ProductGridState
classes.description: The state class managing the scroll controller, data fetching, and UI rendering logic for the `ProductGrid` widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the scroll controller and sets up a listener for lazy loading when nearing the end of the list.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the scroll controller to free resources.

methods.name: _onScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll events; triggers loading more products when near the bottom of the list.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree based on the current state of the products provider, showing loading, error, empty, or populated product grid accordingly.
